scope: Offline synthetic Pump logs and independent paper quotes; mocked historical swap reads and bounded RPC backfill. Each scenario is one run. Before/after use the same harness with legacy/staged adapters and identical offers. Legacy queue capacity 1024 (64 in saturation); new RAM flow 128 and journal pending 10000 (64 in saturation). Durable-burst includes actual filesystem writes, new WAL fsync and Store snapshots. Other scenarios are in-memory. Withheld fixture emission times are known only to this harness; they are not blockchain detection times. Memory peaks are sampled, process maxRSS includes earlier scenarios, event-loop delay uses 10ms sampling. One repeated mint in main fixtures has deliberate PDA cache locality; unique-mint cold decode is measured separately.
